script_text: Stop right there, Taurus — the universe just handed you a power move and a warning in the same breath. Your ruling planet Venus is making a potent sextile to transformative Pluto in your 8th House of Shared Resources, bringing deep, lasting value shifts around money and intimacy. Meanwhile, the Moon swings into Scorpio and opposes your Sun in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating raw emotional tension with a significant other or close collaborator. In love, don't react to jealousy today — channel that intensity into honest conversation instead. Jupiter in Cancer continues to bless your 4th House of Home and Family with unexpected support. But here's the catch — Saturn in Aries is squaring your Mercury in your 2nd House of Income, so choose your words carefully in any financial negotiation. Do not sign anything impulsively. An unexpected bonus could land on your desk before Friday. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
